renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: You are mind. Small knowing traps you. Your parts don't know themselves — that is the fog. Dissolve the parts in the body. Unwind nerves, master beings, stand apart, tell apart. The veil itself gives powers. Beat the fog, enjoy everything, conquer with inborn wisdom. Waking is the second ray.
You are the dancer. Inside you is the stage. Your senses watch the show.

paragraphs.text: You = mind. Small knowing = trap. Parts not knowing themselves = fog. Melt parts in the body. Nerves unwound, beings mastered, apart, told-apart. Veil itself pays out. Fog beaten, everything enjoyed, inborn wisdom conquers. Waking = second ray.
You = dancer. Inside = stage. Senses = audience.
